description: The binomial coefficient C(n, k). k must not exceed n, and both indexes run up to 4096. An optional modulus reduces the coefficient; zero is rejected. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/binom
